Payout of 12 August is short ₹30,997.49.
The bank credited ₹1,82,550.58 against an expected ₹2,13,548.07. 14 orders sit in this payout. No refund, chargeback or payment in the gateway ledger accounts for the difference, so the cause is not yet identified.
Suggested action: request the gateway's own breakdown for this payout, and check for a dispute debited but not yet reported.
